summary.intent: Trim over-engineering from PRs #505, #504 and #507 (skipping #495 and leaving #506's codes alone), then address a review finding on change #115: with git's log.showRoot=false, the batched version-commit query loses the root commit.
summary.outcome: #505, #504 and #507 were trimmed, signed, pushed, and had their bodies updated, with all five repo checks passing and CI running. For #115, the root-commit bug was reproduced with real git, a failing regression test was written, and `--root` was added so the test passes. The signed commit was retried outside the sandbox after the gpg failure; its result isn't shown and nothing was pushed.

repo: Every change is verified by a verify.sh script that runs just pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and workflow-contracts and judges each step by exit code; it must run outside the sandbox.
Lint uses `git ls-files`, so a deleted file must be committed before lint passes.
Commits must be signed (-S); gpg cannot write inside the sandbox, so signed commits need to run outside it.
Reports go through emit_report, and the Report trait forces schemaVersion, which makes a separate JSON contract test redundant.
Branches already checked out in an agent worktree cannot be added to a new worktree; reuse the existing agent worktree instead.
The repo's tooling guard rejects compound git commands, so multi-step repros go into a script file.
Unknown config key rejection (E325 / UnknownField) is handled in callisto-graph config/resolve.rs, but its test coverage was only grepped, not read.

code.finding: The batched `git log --name-only` query needs `--root`. With log.showRoot=false, the root commit appears with a hash but no files and drops out of the index.
An unchanged retry is rejected when the version commit is unknown, so a lost root commit in the index breaks release retries.
Added a real-git regression test (root_commit_is_found) that returned None for the version commit before the fix; the 12 existing version_commit tests still pass.
Removed the wall-clock selection test, which asserted a 10 s bound on 3,000 packages and could flake on a loaded runner.

workflow: Reproduce a review finding with real git before fixing it, and write the regression test first so you see it fail.
Verify claims in PR bodies before publishing them, for example by grepping for the tests that cover a feature.
Check the remote tip with `git ls-remote` after pushing; a push that printed nothing had silently failed and succeeded on retry.
Rewrite the PR title and body whenever the content changes.

friction: gpg signing failed in the sandbox, so the commit had to be retried outside it.
A bare `git push -q` failed without a visible error and needed a retry.
`git worktree add` failed because the branches were already checked out in agent worktrees.
The compound git command in the repro was rejected by the guard, so it was moved into a script.
The user's 'decos' was ambiguous and was interpreted as docs or codes.
open_items: The #115 fix is committed locally but not pushed, and no post-commit verification is shown.
Merge #504, #505 and #507 once CI goes green.
Start the bug-fix PR, which needs a go from the user.
Read the UnknownField tests in config/resolve.rs end to end to confirm the claim in #504's body.
